flags.message: While looking up the originating Fifth Circuit docket 16-70010 via CourtListener MCP (after a pre-cutoff search with filed_before=2017-07-31 returned 0 results because 663 F. App'x 361 is not indexed under 16-70010), an unfiltered docket search returned a snippet from the subsequent remand opinion (706 F. App'x 181, filed 2017-12-12) noting that the Supreme Court later GVR'd the underlying cert petition in light of Moore v. Texas. The post-cutoff opinion was not read and did not disclose the disposition of interim stay application 17A145.
